formula.name: Osmanthus Bois Sec — 30mL EdP
formula.body:
# Osmanthus Bois Sec — 30mL EdP

## Character
Osmanthus apricot-tea blossom floating over a layered dry-cedar forest. Three wood tiers — warm aerial Koavone, architectural Timberol pillars, and extreme-tenacity Norlimbanol Dextro as the foundation. No creamy sandalwood, no chypre darkness. Clean, precise, modern. Think osmanthus meeting Aesop Hwyl in a Comme des Garcons bottle.

**Family**: Woody Floral (architectural) — layered cedar-anchored, osmanthus-centered
**Materials**: 19
**Concentration**: 16% EdP

## Three-Tier Wood Skeleton

| Tier | Material | Dose | VP Pa | Character |
|------|----------|------|:---:|-----------|
| **Canopy** | Koavone | 60 neat | 0.15 | Warm cedar, slightly balsamic — the "forest air" |
| **Structure** | Timberol | 80 neat | 0.02 | Dry architectural cedar — precision, angular |
| **Structure** | Iso E Super | 350 neat | 0.15 | Abstract skin-cocoon — anosmia-prone filler |
| **Structure** | Cedramber | 50 neat | 0.01 | Cedar-amber bridge — warmth between tiers |
| **Foundation** | Norlimbanol Dextro | 40 neat | 0.001 | Extreme tenacity, transparent power — the "floor" |

## Headspace (Composite OAV Model)

| Voice | OAV | Role |
|-------|--:|------|
| Osmanthus Absolute | ~1,500 | The soul — apricot-tea blossom |
| Hedione HC | ~4,500 | Abstract radiance |
| Iso E Super | ~1,500 | Abstract cedar volume |
| Norlimbanol Dextro | ~200 | Powerful transparent — you feel it more than smell it |
| Timberol | ~80 | Dry cedar character |
| Bergamot FCF | ~100 | Opening breath |

## Formula

| # | Ingredient | Dilution | Amount (µL) | Amount (mL) |
|---|-----------|----------|-------------|-------------|
| **🌅 Top** |
| 1 | Bergamot FCF | neat | 70 | 0.070 |
| 2 | Linalool | neat | 35 | 0.035 |
| **💕 Heart** |
| 3 | Osmanthus Absolute | 10% in DPG | 700 | 0.700 |
| 4 | Hedione HC | neat | 900 | 0.900 |
| 5 | Apritone | 10% | 120 | 0.120 |
| 6 | Gamma Decalactone | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 7 | Beta Ionone | 1% in TEC | 100 | 0.100 |
| 8 | Guaiacol | 10% | 20 | 0.020 |
| **🪵 Base** |
| 9 | Koavone | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 10 | Timberol | neat | 80 | 0.080 |
| 11 | Iso E Super | neat | 350 | 0.350 |
| 12 | Cedramber | neat | 50 | 0.050 |
| 13 | Norlimbanol Dextro | neat | 40 | 0.040 |
| 14 | Vertofix | neat | 70 | 0.070 |
| 15 | Romandolide | neat | 200 | 0.200 |
| 16 | Zenolide | neat | 120 | 0.120 |
| 17 | Ethylene Brassylate | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 18 | Ambrettolide | 10% in DPG | 50 | 0.050 |
| 19 | Ambrofix | 30% w/v | 50 | 0.050 |

**Concentrate total**: 4,595 µL (15.3% of 30mL EdP)
**Osmanthus**: 700 µL of 10% in DPG = 70 µL active

## Three-Tier Wood Layering Explained

```
Canopy (VP 0.15-0.01): Koavone + Iso E Super + Cedramber
  ─ The "forest air" — warm, balsamic cedar that reads at opening
  ─ Evaporates by heart phase, leaving...
  
Structure (VP 0.02-0.001): Timberol + Norlimbanol
  ─ The "bones" — dry architectural cedar that persists 6-8h
  ─ Timberol gives the character, Norlimbanol gives the power
  ─ Norlimbanol Dextro = transparent, you feel the wood without smelling it
  
Foundation: Romandolide + Ethylene Brassylate + Vertofix
  ─ The "floor" — musky-woody glue that holds the tiers together
```

## Musk Chord

| Axis | Material | Dose | Function |
|------|----------|------|----------|
| Depth | Ethylene Brassylate | 150 neat | Lactonic skin-sit |
| Projection | Romandolide | 200 neat | Clean diffusive outward |
| Character-echo | Zenolide | 120 neat | Fresh-clean musk |
| Natural warmth | Ambrettolide (10%) | 50 µL | Fruity-wine warmth |

## Why This Should Beat the Chypre + Sandalwood

| Score | Chypre | Sandalwood | Bois Sec | Why |
|-------|:---:|:---:|:---:|------|
| Hedonic | 83.9 | 86.5 | **87+** | No leather OR creaminess. Clean wood = universally liked |
| Sillage | 102 | 91.6 | **100+** | Norlimbanol + Romandolide 200 = projection through walls |
| Luxury | 58.3 | 53.6 | **60+** | Norlimbanol reads as "expensive niche." Layered wood = complexity reward |
| Sophistication | 3.0 | 4.0 | **6+** | Architectural wood = Aesop/Le Labo territory. Modern luxury |
| Elegance | 3.5 | 5.6 | **5+** | 19 materials, clean tiers, visible structure |
| Longevity | 82 | 81.5 | **85+** | Norlimbanol VP 0.001 = 12h+ persistence |

  Step 2. Add Norlimbanol Dextro (1.24%)

           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 7. Add Iso E Super (10.85%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 8. Add Romandolide (6.2%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
